questions.stem:
26. Consider two straight lines \(\ell: 2 x+y-5=0\) and \(L: x-2 y+5=0\). Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(P\) maintains equal distance from \(\ell\) and \(L\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\). Which of the following are true?
I. \(\quad \Gamma\) passes through \((1,3)\).
II. \(\Gamma\) passes through \((1,0)\).
III. \(\Gamma\) consists of two perpendicular straight lines
questions.stemZh:
26. 兩直線 \(\ell\)、\(L\) 的方程分別為 \(2x+y-5=0\)、\(x-2y+5=0\)。動點 \(P\) 到兩直線的距離相等，以 \(\Gamma\) 表示其軌跡。下列哪些敘述正確？
I. \(\Gamma\) 經過 \((1,3)\)。
II. \(\Gamma\) 經過 \((1,0)\)。
III. \(\Gamma\) 由兩條互相垂直的直線組成。
questions.solution: The distance denominators are both \(\sqrt5\), giving \(|2x+y-5|=|x-2y+5|\). The branches are \(x+3y-10=0\) and \(3x-y=0\), with slopes \(-\frac13\) and \(3\), so III is true. \((1,3)\) lies on both branches, so I is true. Substituting \((1,0)\) gives left sides \(-9\) and \(3\), so II is false.
questions.solutionZh:
Q71. mock-cpu-2324-p2-final-q26
答案: B
兩距離分母均為 \(\sqrt5\)，故 \(|2x+y-5|=|x-2y+5|\)。分支為 \(x+3y-10=0\)、\(3x-y=0\)；兩條直線斜率為 \(-\frac13\)、\(3\)，所以 III 正確。\((1,3)\) 同時滿足兩式，故 I 正確；\((1,0)\) 代入兩式的左方分別為 \(-9\)、\(3\)，故 II 錯誤。

questions.stem: Let \(L_1:6x+2y-9=0,L_2:3x+y+9=0\). L1 meets the x-axis at A; L2 meets the y-axis at B. The locus \(\Gamma\) is equidistant from the two lines. Test: I. \(\Gamma\parallel L_1\). II. \(\Gamma\perp AB\). III. \(\Gamma\) passes through the origin.
questions.stemZh:
25. \(L_1:6x+2y-9=0\)、\(L_2:3x+y+9=0\)。\(L_1\) 與 \(x\) 軸交於 \(A\)，\(L_2\) 與 \(y\) 軸交於 \(B\)。動點 \(P\) 與兩線等距，軌跡記為 \(\Gamma\)。
I. \(\Gamma\) 平行於 \(L_1\)。
II. \(\Gamma\) 垂直於 \(AB\)。
III. \(\Gamma\) 通過原點。
下列哪些正確？
questions.solution: The middle parallel is \(3x+y+9/4=0\). It has slope -3 and does not pass through the origin. \(A=(3/2,0),B=(0,-9)\), so AB has slope 6; the product is -18, not -1. Only I is true.
questions.solutionZh: 中間平行線是 \(3x+y+9/4=0\)，斜率為 -3，亦不經原點。\(A=(3/2,0),B=(0,-9)\)，AB 斜率為 6，斜率積 -18 並非 -1。只有 I 正確。
